fact: The article says the government of Guinea is working with the startup FindMe to pilot digital addressing solutions, particularly to upgrade postal services.

Urbanism minister Mory Condé said on 3 October 2024 that a national addressing programme is 100% done in Kaloum commune and will extend to Dixinn, Matam, the other Conakry communes, Coyah, Dubréka and regional and prefecture towns.
An order of the Ministry of Urbanism of 25 August 2025 creates a management unit to implement Guinea's National Addressing Programme, covering naming, numbering, plate standards and the GIS.

WARDIP-Guinée, under the postal and digital economy ministry, presented at Coyah on 13-14 August 2025 the results of a nine-month feasibility study by the Tunisian firm GTC for a digital addressing system and postcodes for Guinea.
